specification.objective: Correct the issue #120 desktop-sidebar transition: avoid intermediate-width RenderFlex overflows and the repeated main-content relayout that makes toggling feel sluggish, while retaining the established 360px/88px modes and all navigation behavior.

requirements.statement: At desktop widths, toggling the shared sidebar still changes between the 360px expanded panel and the 88px icon-only rail, and the main content receives the final available width.
The sidebar width changes directly to its final value without an intermediate width animation; expanded labels and brand controls must never be laid out inside the 88px rail during a transition.
Collapse and expansion emit no Flutter RenderFlex/layout exception, and do not relayout the main content on successive width-animation frames.

All other issue #120 behavior remains unchanged: authorized destinations, active-route indication, accessibility, keyboard focus, session-scoped state, Kanban navigation, and the mobile drawer. This contract supersedes only the optional sidebar-width animation behavior described by issue-120-collapsible-sidebar-v1.
A focused widget regression test toggles both modes with animations enabled, verifies immediate final widths and reclaimed content width, and asserts that tester.takeException() is null.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The regression test passes for collapse and expansion without RenderFlex overflow; after a frame the sidebar is exactly 88px or 360px, never an intermediate width.
The regression test confirms the content pane immediately gets the width corresponding to the selected sidebar mode.
The existing workspace-shell test suite still verifies accessible controls, authorized destinations, breakpoints, and state retention across Kanban navigation.

invariants.statement: The collapse state remains user-triggered and session-scoped; authorization and destination ordering remain owned by the existing navigation model.
The mobile drawer and its layout are not modified.
No width animation means no intermediate geometry and no per-frame width-driven relayout of the workspace content.

forbidden_states.statement: Expanded labels, selected-route indicators, or brand controls are laid out within the collapsed 88px rail.
A toggle emits a RenderFlex overflow or leaves the main content with a stale/intermediate width.
The fix changes mobile navigation, route behavior, authorization, or session-scoped collapse state.

inputs.statement: The current shared desktop sidebar mode, viewport width, and user toggle action.
The selected workspace route, including a selected navigation item during expansion.

outputs.statement: The final sidebar mode and corresponding main-content width in a single layout update.

failure_semantics.statement: The focused widget regression fails if either toggle produces an intermediate width, wrong content width, or any Flutter rendering exception.

argv: desktop sidebar transitions immediately without layout overflow
desktop sidebar transitions immediately without layout overflow

baseline_output_contains: desktop sidebar transitions immediately without layout overflow
